verdict.rationale: Microsoft Copilot documents a Copilot Voice mode: users speak natural-language prompts, receive audio responses, and get conversation transcripts with citations. The docs do not establish real-time, low-latency, interruptible conversation, and there is no hands-on corroboration. missing for 10: documented real-time/low-latency conversational behavior (e.g., interruption, turn-taking), platform availability details for voice mode, independent or hands-on corroboration of voice conversation quality

support.subject: As a knowledge-worker, I can have a natural, real-time voice conversation with the assistant

citations.quote: If users send prompts in natural language voice within the Copilot Voice mode, they will receive audio responses.
provides hyperlinked citations following generated text responses or in conversation transcripts in voice mode
